runs.text: Review notes and optional copy suggestions
Prepared for Jane and Tom Torok • September 15, 2026

blocks.text: The refreshed packet files preserve all supplied wording. No contractual language, rates, or policies were changed. The items below need Jane’s confirmation before any content is revised.

items: Standard packet page 4 is headed “Service Agreement,” but its body contains Veterinary Release language that is duplicated again on page 5. The standard packet therefore does not appear to contain the intended Service Agreement.

The standard packet’s contents list mentions a Service Agreement and an optional Pet Lodging Addendum, but those documents are not present as described. Please confirm which agreement pages belong in this version.

The Rates & Services pages differ materially between the packets. The standard version lists $40 for a 45-minute visit, $50 for one hour, $20 transportation, and three-hour preferred windows; the lodging version lists $34, $42, $15, and two-hour preferred windows. Please confirm whether the lodging packet should retain its older rates or use the newer sheet.
In the Pet Lodging packet’s key reminder, change “we will not be ale to access your home” to “we will not be able to access your home.”
Use “completed and signed” rather than capitalizing “Signed” in the leave-out checklist.
Use “voicemails” as one word instead of “voice mails.”
Standardize “Meet & Greet” capitalization wherever the introductory pages refer to the initial interview.
Rename “The New Client Packet Includes” to “What’s Included in Your Welcome Packet” for a warmer, easier-to-scan heading.
Break the Meet & Greet instructions into three short labeled steps: Meet Your Pet, Review Care Instructions, and Confirm Keys & Paperwork.
Shorten the key paragraph so the emergency consequence is prominent: leaving the key ends Paw Prints’ access for delays or unexpected care needs.
Tighten the Contact Us paragraph by leading with the 8 AM–8 PM business hours and the same-day response goal.
Keep the current warm closing; it fits the Paw Prints promise and balances the formal agreements that follow.

blocks.text: Visual direction used in the refreshed files

items: One consistent deep-green title treatment across agreements and forms.
Soft green and warm-gold field accents instead of neon highlighting.
Paw Prints logo and existing page structure retained.
Original portrait format, page counts, signatures, rates, and contractual wording preserved.
